profile.headline: Software Principal Engineer at Dell Technologies
profile.summary: Over 16 years of experience in kernel programming, device driver, multi core system software, caching software for enterprise storage arrays.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Round Rock, Texas, United States · On-site

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Involved in design and development of unified software for multi point ablation class-III medical device. Also involved in design and development of automation library for automated testing of device's firmware.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Involved in various software development projects for various clients like Dell-EMC, Boston Scientific etc.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Involved in design and development of Active/Active multi core Caching system software (Device Driver) for VNX2 block mid-range storage array. Also involved in development of enhancements and maintenance of existing Caching system software (Device Driver) of CX series block mid-range storage arrays.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Involved in developing intermediate device driver for Network Interface Card (NIC) for Windows platform. Developed software for CNC machine for measuring the polished diamond and identifying the grade of polished diamond using video scanning.
